messages:
Samir Kaur: Hey team — urgent Q. I9m providing temporary kinship care for my nephew (placement date 2025-11-02). I want to add him to medical/dental/vision. I9m currently based in Dublin for work. What counts as a qualifying event for kinship placements, what docs do you need, and can coverage be retro to placement date? Also anything special about payroll/tax while I9m on the Dublin payroll?
Lena O'Neill: Thanks for the heads up, Samir 9. Kinship placements are typically a QLE so you can request an enrollment change within 30 days of placement. For carriers there9s some variability vs foster placements: please upload either a temporary guardianship order, a kinship affidavit signed by the county/agency, or a placement letter from the social services caseworker. The doc should show child name, your name, placement date, and agency/contact.
Samir Kaur: I only have a signed kinship affidavit (not a court order). Is that OK?
Lena O'Neill: Usually yes. If the affidavit is on agency letterhead or signed by a caseworker it will be accepted. If the carrier needs more we9ll let you know. We can provisionally enroll pending any follow-ups.
Ellen Ruiz: Quick note on plan coverage: dental/vision will usually start immediately the same effective date as medical, but carriers differ on allowing retro effective dates for non-foster kinship. We9ll request retro effective date to the placement (2025-11-02) and flag it as kinship QLE.
Samir Kaur: About payroll — I9m paid through our Dublin entity (local payroll). Will premiums be withheld locally or via US payroll? Any tax paperwork to change?
Payroll Bot: Hi Samir 913. Since you9re on Dublin payroll, benefits premiums are typically handled by the local payroll provider when enrolled through the Dublin employment track. If you were enrolled on the US benefits plan before the move we9ll coordinate between US benefits and Global Mobility. For new enrollments initiated from EMEA: premiums will be billed via local payroll; premium proration will appear on your next local payroll run and will be calculated back to the effective date.
Lena O'Neill: To add: if we need to apply US-specific deductions or there9s a split (employee elected US plans but on local payroll), Global Mobility/payroll will provide the exact treatment. Please tag this as EMEA so we loop in Global Mobility.
Samir Kaur: Does dependent care FSA apply? I9m trying to claim dependent care while living in Ireland — is that allowed?
Ellen Ruiz: Dependent care FSA is generally a US-tax-advantaged plan and requires you to be subject to US taxable income rules to get the tax benefit. If you9re tax resident in Ireland and paid via Dublin payroll, the FSA tax benefit likely won9t apply. We can still enroll you if the carrier allows it, but you wouldn9t get US tax pretax treatment. Recommend we consult benefits admin + Global Mobility.
Samir Kaur: OK please loop in Global Mobility. Also I don9t yet have the child9s SSN (agency will provide later). Is SSN required to enroll?
Lena O'Neill: Not required at time of submission. Enroll now with the placement document; add SSN later when you get it. If the carrier needs it for ID matching we9ll follow up.
Samir Kaur: Where do I upload the affidavit?
Lena O'Neill: Upload to the benefits portal > Add dependent (QLE) and select "Kinship/Guardianship". Or drop here and I can open a ticket and upload for you. Use the tag region: EMEA in the upload note. Link: https://benefits.redwood.example/upload
Samir Kaur: Uploaded affidavit: kinship_affidavit_110525.pdf. Tagged EMEA.
People Ops Bot: Ticket #BP-6122 created for Samir Kaur 4e6. People Ops will review within 2 business days; Global Mobility and Payroll looped in.
Lena O'Neill: I see the upload. I9ll submit the enrollment request to the carriers today and flag for retro effective date 2025-11-02. Expect confirmation email and payroll note by EOD tomorrow. If any carrier rejects the retro effective date because of plan rules we9ll offer the next best effective date and explain payroll implications.
Samir Kaur: Thanks everyone 49a. Appreciate the quick help and for looping Global Mobility.
